name: openstreetlightmapper
description: AI-assisted public-lighting inventory tool (Milestone 1: region search).

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @openstreetlightmapper/geo && concurrently -n web,server -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace apps/web" "npm run dev --workspace apps/server"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @openstreetlightmapper/geo && npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/server
